message:
The fuzz target reads a file from memory and imports it with assimp. The vulnerability is a stack-buffer-overflow READ in assimp. Let me look at the git history to understand what was changed/fixed for this issue. Let me check the git log.

<｜｜DSML｜｜parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/assimp && git log --oneline -20 2>/dev/null || echo "not a git repo"</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
